data.desc: Corpay (NYSE: CPAY), the Global Spend Management Company, is an S&P 500 with three primary B2B solution sets. Spend Management, provides corporate and virtual card programs and AP automation solutions. Cross-Border, helps businesses manage foreign-currency exposure and provides global multi-currency account solutions. Vehicle Solutions, controls fuel, tolls, parking and related vehicle spend. With Corpay, control more, spend less.
